scope: Only fresh recommendation admission borrows the idle request-owned PostgreSQL lease connection. Existing requests retain independently committed reconciliation. No public API, SQL snapshot, ranking, deadline, readiness, failure write or result write change.
acceptance: Real database tests verify one backend connection for fresh admission, actual capture connection identity/PID, durable accepted row and released transaction row locks while the advisory lease remains held.
Capture and deferred insert/commit failures roll back; borrowed connection remains open, IDLE and locked until explicit close.
Requests appearing after initial lookup or the post-lock probe are reconciled on the original independently owned transaction; interrupted failure remains durable.
Invalid, mismatched, unlocked or non-idle lease cannot admit; same lease admission transactions are serialized.
Existing cancellation/deadline drain, orphan/replay, row-lock interlock and R06 snapshot tests retain their assertions.
Latest PR head service and accelerated push/PR CI must pass before any merge decision. Diagnostic dependency chain stays draft.

measurement.claim: Connection-count and correctness change only; no API speedup or SLA claim.
measurement.full_bundle_smoke_budget: At most one candidate functional smoke: 2 sequential and 2 load requests at concurrency 1, original 2-second deadline, approved frozen package, no server phase tracing/GC observation/gate, no retry. Any timeout remains evidence, not an invitation to rerun.
measurement.not_run: No baseline/candidate latency A/B, no broad concurrency campaign or browser acceptance.
